pages.title: Oppenheimer's Hat
pages.text: The signature wide-brimmed porkpie hat worn by Dr. J. Robert Oppenheimer during the Trinity test.$(br2)Can be acquired from a Manhattan Physicist in exchange for 8 Trinitite gathered from atomic blast craters.

pages.title: Post-Game Research
pages.text: When fused with companion entities in the Transmutation Cube, the hat catalyzes strange temporal echoes of the Manhattan Project team, producing curious results such as J. Paco Barkkenheimer.

pages.title: Dungeon Toilet
pages.text: Occasionally discovered deep in subterranean monster dungeons. Serves literally zero survival or tactical purpose, but can now be oriented facing in all 4 directions.$(br2)Right-clicking triggers a pungent malodorous sound effect and sends the porcelain fixture sinking through the floor!

pages.title: Chocolate Pudding
pages.text: Found as rare joke loot in subterranean dungeon chests alongside the toilet.$(br2)A completely ridiculous confection that can be placed down to eat in 7 slices, or eaten directly from the hand with comical squishing sound effects!
